standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: One day Suzie McCash went shopping with her mum in Tynemouth, England.
entries.zh: 一天，苏茜·麦卡什和妈妈去英格兰的泰恩茅斯购物。

entries.en: Suzie was four years old.
entries.zh: 苏茜当时四岁。

entries.en: Her mum didn’t feel very well at the shops, so they went home.
entries.zh: 妈妈在商店里觉得很不舒服，于是她们回家了。

entries.en: In the house, Suzie’s mum went to lie on the sofa.
entries.zh: 回到家，苏茜的妈妈去躺在沙发上。

entries.en: She was there for a long time.
entries.zh: 她在那里躺了很久。

entries.en: Her eyes were shut and it wasn’t easy for her to breathe.
entries.zh: 她闭着眼睛，呼吸也很困难。

entries.en: Suzie was worried.
entries.zh: 苏茜很担心。

entries.en: Was her mum really ill?
entries.zh: 妈妈真的病了吗？

entries.en: Suzie went to the house next door, but the neighbours weren’t there.
entries.zh: 苏茜去了隔壁的房子，可邻居不在家。

entries.en: So she phoned 999 – the emergency telephone number for the police.
entries.zh: 于是她拨打了 999——报警用的紧急电话号码。

entries.en: The police officer was very kind and Suzie was calm.
entries.zh: 警察很和善，苏茜也很镇定。

entries.en: ‘What’s your mummy doing now?’
entries.zh: “你妈妈现在在做什么？”

entries.en: ‘Um, she’s just sitting on the sofa and she’s doing nothing.’
entries.zh: “嗯，她只是坐在沙发上，什么也不做。”

entries.en: ‘Are her eyes open?’
entries.zh: “她的眼睛睁着吗？”

entries.en: ‘No, they’re shut.’
entries.zh: “没有，闭着。”

entries.en: And later…
entries.zh: 后来……

entries.en: ‘Can you open the door?
entries.zh: “你能开门吗？

entries.en: Can you be a big girl?’
entries.zh: 你能像个大孩子一样做到吗？”

entries.en: Soon the police were at their house and an ambulance was there, too.
entries.zh: 很快，警察和救护车都到了她们家。

entries.en: About an hour later, Suzie’s mum was OK again.
entries.zh: 大约一小时后，苏茜的妈妈没事了。

entries.en: A doctor said: ‘Her mummy was very sick.
entries.zh: 医生说：“她妈妈病得很重。

entries.en: Without Suzie’s phone call, her mummy might be dead now.’
entries.zh: 要是没有苏茜那个电话，她妈妈现在可能已经死了。”

entries.en: Suzie’s story was in the newspapers and people were surprised and happy about it.
entries.zh: 苏茜的故事登上了报纸，人们既惊讶又高兴。

entries.en: She was a very brave girl and, a year later, she was in the news again because she was named a Child of Courage at the Pride of Britain Awards for helping her mother.
entries.zh: 她是个非常勇敢的女孩，一年后她再次上了新闻，因为帮助妈妈的行为，她被评为英国骄傲奖的“勇气儿童”。
